name: Himekawa Ikuyo
source:
Club activity: Nurse Study Group (and health committee)
Hobbies: Horror films appreciation (She faints while doing that)
The trouble is that: When she falls, she butts-heads with the person she chooses.

Belongs to [url=/c4281]Kaoru[/url]'s group of friends.
